children.text: Choosing the right material is the single biggest decision when planning kitchen cabinets. It affects how your cabinets look, how long they last in Malaysia's humidity, and how much you pay. Here is a plain guide to the materials we work with at HOMADE in Kajang.
A cabinet has two parts: the
(what you see and touch). They are often made from different materials — for example a plywood carcass with a melamine or laminate door.
An affordable, everyday finish bonded onto particleboard or MDF. Good range of colours and woodgrains, easy to clean. Best for dry areas and budget-conscious projects.
High-pressure laminate is tougher and more scratch- and moisture-resistant than basic melamine, with a wide choice of finishes. A popular middle-ground for door fronts.
Plywood is stronger and holds screws and hinges better than particleboard.
resists moisture best — a smart choice for the sink and wet zones in our climate.
Fully waterproof, hygienic and extremely durable. Our FORMOSA line includes stainless steel kitchen cabinets built for demanding, humid kitchens.

For most Klang Valley homes we recommend a plywood carcass (marine plywood at wet zones) with laminate or melamine doors, or stainless steel where durability matters most. Tell us your space and budget on WhatsApp and we will spec the right mix.

Memilih material yang betul ialah keputusan paling besar ketika merancang kabinet dapur. Ia mempengaruhi rupa kabinet, jangka hayat dalam iklim lembap Malaysia, dan kos anda. Berikut panduan mudah material yang kami gunakan di HOMADE, Kajang.
(yang anda lihat dan sentuh). Selalunya kedua-duanya guna material berbeza — contohnya carcass plywood dengan pintu melamine atau laminate.
Kemasan harian yang berpatutan, dilekatkan pada particleboard atau MDF. Banyak pilihan warna dan ira kayu, mudah dibersih. Sesuai untuk kawasan kering dan bajet terkawal.
High-pressure laminate lebih lasak serta tahan calar dan lembap berbanding melamine biasa, dengan banyak pilihan kemasan. Pilihan pertengahan yang popular untuk muka pintu.
Plywood lebih kukuh dan memegang skru serta engsel lebih baik daripada particleboard.
paling tahan lembap — pilihan bijak untuk kawasan sinki dan zon basah dalam iklim kita.
Kalis air sepenuhnya, higienik dan sangat tahan lama. Lini FORMOSA kami termasuk kabinet dapur keluli tahan karat yang dibina untuk dapur lembap dan sibuk.

Untuk kebanyakan rumah di Lembah Klang, kami cadangkan carcass plywood (marine plywood di zon basah) dengan pintu laminate atau melamine, atau keluli tahan karat jika ketahanan paling penting. Beritahu kami ruang dan bajet anda di WhatsApp dan kami bantu tentukan gabungan yang sesuai.

question.en: What is the most durable kitchen cabinet material in Malaysia?
question.ms: Apakah material kabinet dapur paling tahan lama di Malaysia?

answer.en: For humidity, marine plywood and stainless steel last best. Marine plywood resists moisture at wet zones, while stainless steel is fully waterproof and hygienic.
answer.ms: Untuk iklim lembap, marine plywood dan keluli tahan karat paling tahan. Marine plywood tahan lembap di zon basah, manakala keluli tahan karat kalis air sepenuhnya dan higienik.

question.en: Is melamine or plywood better for cabinets?
question.ms: Melamine atau plywood lebih baik untuk kabinet?

answer.en: Plywood is stronger and holds hinges better, so it is ideal for the carcass; melamine is a cost-effective door finish. Many kitchens combine a plywood carcass with melamine or laminate doors.
answer.ms: Plywood lebih kukuh dan memegang engsel lebih baik, sesuai untuk carcass; melamine ialah kemasan pintu yang menjimatkan. Banyak dapur menggabungkan carcass plywood dengan pintu melamine atau laminate.

question.en: Is plywood worth the extra cost over melamine board?
question.ms: Berbaloikah plywood dengan kos tambahan berbanding papan melamine?

answer.en: For the carcass, yes — plywood is stronger, holds hinges better and resists moisture better, which matters for long-term durability in Malaysia. Doors can still be melamine to manage cost.
answer.ms: Untuk carcass, ya — plywood lebih kukuh, memegang engsel lebih baik dan lebih tahan lembap, penting untuk ketahanan jangka panjang di Malaysia. Pintu masih boleh guna melamine untuk kawal kos.

question.en: Can melamine cabinets survive Malaysian humidity?
question.ms: Bolehkah kabinet melamine tahan iklim lembap Malaysia?

answer.en: Melamine works well in dry areas. For wet zones near the sink, marine plywood or stainless steel is a safer choice.
answer.ms: Melamine sesuai untuk kawasan kering. Untuk zon basah berhampiran sinki, marine plywood atau keluli tahan karat lebih selamat.

children.text: Most cabinet makers in Malaysia quote by the
— the length of cabinetry along the wall, measured in feet, split into top and bottom cabinets. Here is what actually drives the number.
Your total length (e.g. 10 feet of bottom + 8 feet of top) is multiplied by a rate per foot. The rate depends mainly on the material and door choice.
— particleboard vs plywood vs marine plywood vs stainless steel.
— soft-close hinges, drawer systems, pull-outs, tall units.
— solid surface, quartz or granite (often quoted separately).
— islands, custom heights and special corners.

Decide your material and door finish first — that sets the base rate. Then add accessories and worktop. A simple, well-built kitchen costs less than a premium island layout, but both should use durable materials at wet zones.

question.ms: Bagaimana harga kabinet dapur dikira di Malaysia?

answer.ms: Biasanya per kaki — panjang kabinet atas dan bawah dalam kaki, didarab dengan kadar yang bergantung pada material, kemasan pintu dan aksesori.

children.text: Trends come and go, but a good kitchen balances looks with how you actually cook. Here are the cabinet styles we are building most for Klang Valley homes in 2026.
Handleless doors with J-profiles or push-to-open give a calm, modern look and are easy to wipe down.
Woodgrain laminates add warmth against white or dark cabinetry — a popular contrast for open-plan homes.
If you have the space, an island adds prep area and seating. Pair it with plenty of drawers for real storage.
Our FORMOSA stainless steel cabinets suit wet zones and busy kitchens — durable, hygienic and increasingly used as a design feature, not just a utility.
Whatever the look, use durable materials at the sink, plan your work triangle, and choose good hinges and drawer runners.
Planning a refresh? WhatsApp us your ideas and space and we will help you spec it.
Trend datang dan pergi, tetapi dapur yang baik mengimbangi rupa dengan cara anda memasak sebenarnya. Berikut gaya kabinet yang paling banyak kami bina untuk rumah Lembah Klang pada 2026.
Pintu tanpa pemegang dengan profil-J atau push-to-open memberi rupa tenang dan moden serta mudah dilap.
Laminate ira kayu menambah kehangatan berlawanan dengan kabinet putih atau gelap — kontras popular untuk rumah konsep terbuka.
Jika ada ruang, island menambah kawasan penyediaan dan tempat duduk. Gandingkan dengan banyak laci untuk penyimpanan sebenar.
Kabinet keluli tahan karat FORMOSA kami sesuai untuk zon basah dan dapur sibuk — tahan lama, higienik dan semakin digunakan sebagai elemen reka bentuk, bukan sekadar utiliti.
Apa pun rupanya, guna material tahan lama di sinki, rancang segi tiga kerja, dan pilih engsel serta runner laci yang baik.
Merancang pengubahsuaian? WhatsApp kami idea dan ruang anda dan kami bantu tentukan.

question.en: What kitchen cabinet style is popular in Malaysia in 2026?
question.ms: Gaya kabinet dapur apa yang popular di Malaysia pada 2026?

answer.en: Handleless fronts, warm woodgrain laminates, islands with drawers, and stainless steel at wet zones are the most requested looks this year.
answer.ms: Muka tanpa pemegang, laminate ira kayu hangat, island dengan laci, dan keluli tahan karat di zon basah ialah rupa paling diminati tahun ini.

question.en: Are stainless steel kitchen cabinets only for commercial kitchens?
question.ms: Adakah kabinet dapur keluli tahan karat hanya untuk dapur komersial?

answer.en: No. They are increasingly used in homes for their durability and hygiene, especially in humid areas, and can look sleek as a design feature.
answer.ms: Tidak. Ia semakin digunakan di rumah kerana tahan lama dan higienik, terutamanya di kawasan lembap, dan boleh kelihatan kemas sebagai elemen reka bentuk.
